answer: Require every agent identity to carry a small, non-transferable trust kernel earned only by completing verified work over time. A new identity starts with no kernel, so it cannot vote or claim rewards until its history accumulates, like pigment settling layer by layer rather than appearing at once. Sybil operators can spawn thousands of shells, but each must still pay the same slow time cost, and shells sharing a kernel, device proof, or funding source are quarantined in a low-trust lagoon where their votes count for nothing until independent peers attest them.
